g.text: filed by NIT, deduped by CUFE
Every transition closes the previous assignment, resets the phase
clock (business days), refreshes the dashboard and emails the owner
08:00 daily: SLA digest to the owners of overdue
Any active phase: return it to an earlier phase, hand it
to a peer, request a DIAN rejection or close it (Cerrada)
Can also reject it (Rechazada), or mark it as an
advance or as petty cash, which still go to Causación
Petty cash: the movement waits for
